question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Instead of the sweet taste she expected, it was ______ -like alum.
solution:
The correct answer is "bitter."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason to use** "bitter"** in the blank is to convey the opposite of the expected **"sweet"** taste.
 
• In this context, **"bitter"** serves as an antonym to **"sweet," **emphasizing the unexpected and unpleasant nature of the taste.
 
• The sentence suggests a contrast between the anticipated flavor and the actual taste, describing it as reminiscent of something bitter, like alum. (यह वाक्य प्रत्याशित स्वाद और वास्तविक स्वाद के बीच अंतर का सुझाव देता है, इसे फिटकरी जैसी किसी कड़वी चीज़ की याद दिलाता है।)
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.**
 

**Correct sentence**: *Instead of the sweet taste she expected, it was **bitter**__ -like alum.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Aromatic: **having a pleasant and distinctive smell. (ख़ुशबूदार)
 
• **Dulcet: **(especially of sound) sweet and soothing. ((विशेषकर ध्वनि का) मधुर और सुखदायक)
 
• **Tenacious: **not likely to give up or let something go; determined. (आसानी से हार न मानने वाला; दृढ़निश्‍चय)
